decision: Commit 2 of #3794 moves active scope, the story file_scope fence and assist-scratch classification to effectiveRoot; authz, the audit trail, the kill-switch and the #2885 outside-root carve-out stay on payloadRoot

governingRule.description: Root selection for a mutation gate must name the tree the write lands in, and an authorization frame is only relocated deliberately

alternativesConsidered.option: Move every projectRoot consumer in inspectMutationGates to effectiveRoot
Leave scope and file_scope on payloadRoot and accept the wrong-tree gating
Also move the #2885 outside-root carve-out to effectiveRoot

whyWinner: The round-1 panel measured that authz grant scoping is an exact string match, the audit trail is repository-global evidence, and the kill-switch is untracked and therefore absent from linked worktrees; each breaks a live behaviour if re-pointed. The #2885 carve-out was pinned by the same enumeration, so worktrees under the payload root gain scope gating while worktrees outside it keep today's skip
revisitTrigger: If a worktree outside the payload root needs active-scope gating, the #2885 carve-out has to be re-derived rather than widened here
